trends.name: Iran Ceasefire Collapse Risk
trends.summary: Iran claims US/Israel violated 10-point ceasefire proposal before negotiations began; Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf signals negotiations unreasonable. Iran now restricting Strait of Hormuz passage to ~12 ships/day with new toll system, reversing Trump's 'complete opening' claims. Oil tankers already turning around, signaling immediate geopolitical risk.

trends.name: Oil Price Collapse & Energy Sector Rally
trends.summary: Crude oil posted largest single-day drop since 2020 (-13.29%), with Brent settling at $94.75/bbl. Energy sector ($XLE) up +55% YoY despite volatility. EIA projects petroleum consumption down 11-23% by 2050 due to EV adoption, Brent staying below $70/bbl through 2030. Initial rally in retail/travel stocks faces uncertainty if ceasefire deteriorates.

trends.name: Fed Rate Cut Expectations Persist
trends.summary: March FOMC minutes show many Fed officials still expect rate cuts despite inflation concerns. Recession probability on Kalshi markets now 27%, down from earlier peaks. Market pricing in multiple rate cuts through 2026, supporting equity valuations but creating bond-stock divergence concerns.

trends.name: Tech Sector AI Leadership & Meta Competition
trends.summary: Google expanding AI lead in key markets, supporting Alphabet stock thesis. Meta debuts new AI model after multi-billion dollar spending spree, attempting to catch OpenAI and Google. Tech sector ($XLK) leads with +59% YoY gains. Competition heating up as majors justify massive capex investment in generative AI.

trends.name: Stock Market Technical Warning Signals
trends.summary: SPY trading above 50/200 DMAs intraday but closing below both — rare setup last seen 3 times since 2003, each followed by -13% to -16% declines within weeks. BTIG flagging bearish technical setup despite recent Iran ceasefire rally. Bond market divergence reinforces caution vs. equity enthusiasm.

trends.name: Infrastructure Stocks & Power Grid Strain
trends.summary: Data center demand straining US power grid infrastructure, attracting smart-money interest in infrastructure stocks. Hardware/home improvement stocks rallying as oil price drop lowers input costs. Long-term secular trend of AI/cloud computing infrastructure investment creating tailwinds for grid modernization plays.

trends.name: Private Credit Market Stress
trends.summary: Jefferies warns private credit market weighed on Wall Street despite broader boom in capital markets. Rising interest rates and slower exit environments creating liquidity challenges for alternative credit investors. Potential source of financial system stress if credit conditions deteriorate further.

trends.name: Biotech Obesity/GLP-1 Drug Pipeline
trends.summary: Structure Therapeutics advancing oral obesity treatments with best-in-class efficacy and safety profile (biased-agonism approach). GLP-1 market remains high-growth opportunity as oral formulations gain acceptance. Positioning within $100B+ addressable market for weight loss pharmaceuticals.

trends.name: FedEx Transformation & Logistics Earnings
trends.summary: FedEx Analyst/Investor Day highlighting operational transformation and margin improvement initiatives. Logistics/shipping sector benefiting from supply chain normalization. Key bellwether for consumer spending and e-commerce activity; earnings guidance critical for sector outlook.

trends.name: Natural Gas Oversupply & Price Floor
trends.summary: US natural gas production exceeds demand capacity, creating structural price support for consumers and utilities. Oversupply insulating Americans from Iran oil disruption impacts; LNG export challenges keeping domestic supply elevated. Long-term pressure on natural gas prices benefits industrial consumers.

trends.name: Mexico Trucking Strike & Supply Chain Risk
trends.summary: Nationwide Mexican trucking strike blocking key freight routes, threatening cross-border supply chains critical to US manufacturing and retail. Emerging logistical pressure point amid geopolitical tensions; inflation risk if disruption persists. Could impact consumer prices and corporate margins.

trends.name: Bitcoin/Crypto Regulatory Scrutiny
trends.summary: Investigation into Bitcoin founder ties identity to Blockstream CEO Adam Back, raising regulatory and transparency concerns. Part of broader crypto industry regulatory pressure. Sentiment headwind for digital asset adoption narratives amid compliance questions.
